stories.title: Senedd election 2026: Identical projection in both Flintshire seats — two Reform, two Plaid, one Labour, one Tory
stories.summary: Reform UK and Plaid Cymru are each projected to win two seats in both of the new Senedd constituencies covering Flintshire, with Welsh Labour and the Welsh Conservatives taking one each, according to the final pre-election MRP poll for ITV Cymru Wales. stories.title: Flintshire County Council seeks new Local Access Forum members

stories.title: Mancot man jailed for life for raping three children
stories.summary: A man from Mancot has been jailed for life for raping three children and sexually abusing a fourth. Daniel Bremner, 35, was sentenced at Mold Crown Court on Friday 1 May after pleading guilty to 35 offences. He must serve a minimum of 15 years before he can apply for parole.
